    About this project

    I was inspired by TheyRule to bring more transparency to Columbus politics.

    This map follows the people, organizations, money and public decisions that shape Columbus. It starts with a few connections and grows as you explore. Each connection opens the records and sources behind it.

    Project on GitHub · MIT code · CC BY 4.0 curated data

    Third-party materials keep their own terms. Privacy

    Help build the picture →

    Help build the picture

    Found a missing connection, a better source or something that needs correcting? Contributions go through GitHub.

    A useful suggestion includes the person or organization, the connection, and a link to the document or reporting behind it. The record link in the details panel makes it easy to point to an existing entry.

    Code, design and accessibility improvements are welcome too.

    Contribute on GitHub ↗

    Get in touch

    Questions, feedback and corrections go through the project’s GitHub issues. That keeps the conversation with the project and makes updates easy to follow.

    GitHub issues are public, so this channel is for information you’re comfortable sharing openly.

    Contact through GitHub ↗

    About the records

    Status

    Evidence labels describe the statement behind each connection: a finding, allegation, participant account or documented record. Its source and qualifications appear in the details.

    Money & authority

    Arrows show the recorded direction. Amounts identify payments, funding, spending ceilings, asset values or penalties. Each amount belongs to its own recipient and period.

    Sources

    Source links lead to the cited documents, with page or paragraph references where recorded. Source information includes the research method and check date.

    Coverage

    State and federal politics, campaign money, contracts, lobbying, HB 6, Wexner–Epstein, Redflex, and selected affiliations. Authorizations are distinct from payments. Node size counts dataset links; placement is for readability.
